SAYELF STORYLEAF includes the GSAP 3.15.0 browser distribution.

Project: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP
Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
Standard license: https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/

The bundled file keeps its original GSAP header. SAYELF uses GSAP as a runtime
animation capability; it is not a separate Skill and it does not receive user
stories, prompts, media, or credentials.
